name: Steering Wheel & Quick Release
description: Race steering wheel, quick-release coupling and the hub adapter (boss) that fits the Gen 6 column spline, plus button/horn wiring through the quick release.

components.name: Steering wheel
components.description: Factory ZL1 wheel is a sueded flat-bottom wheel with airbag, paddles (10-speed) and controls. Race cars use a 330-350 mm suede/leather race wheel on a quick release, often with a CAN or wired button module for radio, pit limiter, display page, etc.

factory.name: GM ZL1 flat-bottom sueded steering wheel with driver airbag
factory.notes: Steering wheel bolt: 45 N·m (33 lb ft).

raceOptions.name: OMP / Sparco / MOMO 330-350 mm race wheel (6x70 mm PCD)
raceOptions.notes: Smaller diameter increases effort with EPS; 350 mm is a common compromise for heavier cars.

hardware.item: Steering wheel bolt (OE wheel / hub adapter to column)

hardware.spec: M5 x 0.8 countersunk or button head (6 x 70 mm PCD)
hardware.notes: Typical manufacturer value; follow wheel/QR instructions.

installNotes: Disable SRS (disconnect battery, wait per GM) before removing the OE airbag wheel.
Index the wheel straight with the rack centered.

images.title: Chevrolet 2019 Camaro ZL1 product guide (suspension types, ZF EPS, track 1610/1591 mm, DSSV, 3-way rear bar)

modelRef.dimensions: 350 mm dia, approx 50-70 mm dish, 6 x 70 mm PCD
modelRef.features: Three-spoke dished race wheel, suede rim, 12 o'clock marker; face perpendicular to the column, facing the driver

components.name: Steering wheel quick release
components.description: Splined coupling that lets the driver remove the wheel for entry/exit and allows safety crews quick access. Required or strongly recommended by most sanctioning bodies when a window net/cage makes entry tight. Choose a type with zero lash and positive locking.
components.location: Between hub adapter and wheel, approx (x 1.21, y 0.78, z 0.37).

raceOptions.name: Works Bell Rapfix
raceOptions.notes: Low-lash; electrical contacts available for horn.

raceOptions.name: OMP / Sparco / Momo race quick release (splined, with or without electrical contacts)

hardware.spec: M5 or M6 socket head (per kit)

installNotes: Check for rotational lash after install; any play is felt as steering slop.
inspection: Check locking collar and spline wear.

modelRef.features: Two-piece ball-lock quick release (hub half + wheel half, pull collar)

components.name: Hub adapter (boss kit) for Gen 6 column spline
components.description: Adapter that fits the Gen 6 Camaro column spline and center bolt and presents a standard 6 x 70 mm (or QR) interface. Must be specific to the 2016+ Camaro spline. Some adapters include horn contact provisions and clockspring/SRS resistor notes.
components.location: On column spline, approx (x 1.17, y 0.765, z 0.37).

raceOptions.name: Gen 6 Camaro short hub adapter
raceOptions.notes: Verify 2016+ Camaro application; part numbers not verified here.

hardware.spec: OE center bolt or kit bolt

installNotes: Set rack center and index hub so the wheel is straight.

modelRef.features: Short splined boss kit for the Gen 6 column, 6 x 70 mm flange

components.name: Horn / steering-wheel button wiring through quick release
components.description: Wiring for horn (if required), radio PTT, pit limiter, flash, display page etc. Options: (1) quick release with electrical contacts plus short coil cord; (2) coiled cable with a connector that the driver unplugs before removing the wheel; (3) wireless or CAN button module with only power/CAN through a QR connector. The OE clockspring is often retained only as a pass-through.

factory.name: GM SIR clockspring + wheel control circuits

raceOptions.name: Coiled cord with Deutsch/Autosport connector, or CAN keypad
raceOptions.notes: Keep connector strain-relieved; ensure it releases without damage if driver exits in a hurry.

installNotes: Route so it cannot wrap around the column at full lock (approx 1.25-1.5 turns each way).
inspection: Check connector and cord for fatigue.
